import os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P="/agent/jobs/b4cc24f7-7d34-4678-9427-998ab6e19307/provenance"; os.chdir(P)
cons=pd.read_csv("catalytic_positions_ortholog_conservation.csv")
pp=pd.read_csv("partner_conservation_table.csv")
cav=json.load(open("cavity_and_interfaces.json")); sh=json.load(open("phd_shielding.json"))
master=pd.read_csv("PHD_master_table.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13.5,9))

# A: catalytic positions
a=ax[0,0]; c=cons.sort_values("hDUOX1_pos")
lab=[f"{r.LPO_aa}{r.site.split('LPO ')[1][:-1][1:]} -> {r.hDUOX1_aa}{r.hDUOX1_pos}" for r in c.itertuples()]
y=np.arange(len(c))
a.barh(y,c["frac_with_LPO_residue"],color="#b03030")
a.barh(y,1-c["frac_with_LPO_residue"],left=c["frac_with_LPO_residue"],color="#c8c8c8")
a.set_yticks(y); a.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=9); a.invert_yaxis()
a.set_xlabel("fraction of 140 vertebrate DUOX1/DUOX2 orthologs\nkeeping the lactoperoxidase residue")
a.set_title("A  Heme-ligand and catalytic positions are lost\nacross vertebrate DUOX orthologs",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for i,r in enumerate(c.itertuples()):
    a.text(0.02,i,f"{r.frac_with_LPO_residue:.0%} (modal {r.modal_aa}, {r.modal_frac:.0%})",
           va="center",fontsize=8,color="white" if r.frac_with_LPO_residue>0.2 else "black")
a.set_xlim(0,1)

# B: per-partner conservation
b=ax[0,1]; x=np.arange(len(pp)); w=0.38
b.bar(x-w/2,pp["med_iface"],w,label="at interface",color="#2a6f97")
b.bar(x+w/2,pp["med_other"],w,label="rest of PHD surface",color="#c8c8c8")
b.set_xticks(x); b.set_xticklabels([s.replace(" (","\n(") for s in pp["partner"]],fontsize=8)
b.set_ylabel("median % identity across orthologs"); b.legend(fontsize=8)
for i,r in enumerate(pp.itertuples()):
    b.text(i,max(r.med_iface,r.med_other)+0.02,f"n={r.n_iface}\np={r.p:.1e}" if r.p<0.05 else f"n={r.n_iface}\np={r.p:.2f}",
           ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
b.set_ylim(0,1.18)
b.set_title("B  Conserved PHD surface sits at the DUOXA1 and NOX-module\ninterfaces, not the PHD-PHD interface",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# C: buried surface budget
c2=ax[1,0]
vals=[sh["TM_buried_by_PHD"],sh["DUOXA1B_buried_by_PHD"],sh["heme1602_sasa_noPHD"]-sh["heme1602_sasa_withPHD"]]
nm=["DUOX1 TM/NOX\nburied by PHD","DUOXA1 (cis)\nburied by PHD","outer heme\noccluded by PHD"]
c2.bar(nm,vals,color=["#2a6f97","#2a6f97","#b03030"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): c2.text(i,v+30,f"{v:.0f} $\\AA^2$",ha="center",fontsize=9)
c2.set_ylabel("buried / occluded surface ($\\AA^2$)")
c2.set_title("C  The PHD caps the NOX module and DUOXA1,\nnot the oxygen-reduction site",fontsize=10,loc="left")

# D: cavity + pocket burial
d=ax[1,1]
d.bar(["lactoperoxidase\n(heme removed)","human DUOX1 PHD"],
      [cav["cavity_LPO_A3"],cav["cavity_DUOX1_A3"]],color=["#777777","#b03030"])
for i,v in enumerate([cav["cavity_LPO_A3"],cav["cavity_DUOX1_A3"]]):
    d.text(i,v+10,f"{v:.0f} $\\AA^3$",ha="center",fontsize=9)
d.set_ylabel("free volume at the heme site ($\\AA^3$)")
pk=master.loc[master["pocket"],"rsa_alone"]; ob=master.loc[master["buried"]&~master["pocket"],"rsa_alone"]
d.text(0.5,0.55,f"pocket residues: median RSA {pk.median():.2f}\n29 lining residues, 22 atoms within\n2.5 $\\AA$ of the superposed heme\n(Glu327 OE1 1.6 $\\AA$ from modelled Fe)",
       transform=d.transAxes,fontsize=8.5,ha="center",
       bbox=dict(fc="#f2f2f2",ec="#999999"))
d.set_title("D  The ancestral heme pocket is collapsed,\nnot empty",fontsize=10,loc="left")

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
